summary: Concise summary of Claude Code sub-agent architecture and limitations.

mechanisms.isolation: Each sub-agent runs in an isolated context window with its own system prompt, tool allow/deny lists, memory scope, optional MCP, and optional git worktree isolation.
lifecycle: spawn -> SubagentStart event -> execute (foreground or background) -> SubagentStop -> results returned to parent
mechanisms.communication: Parent-mediated. Subagent results are returned to the parent; no documented P2P sub-agent messaging or nesting (subagents cannot spawn subagents).
mechanisms.permissions: permissionMode and upfront permissions for background tasks; background subagents cannot AskUserQuestion after launch unless permissioned.
mechanisms.limitations: No documented peer-to-peer sub-agent channels, no nested spawning, no public IPC/message schema, and no scheduler internals exposed in public docs.
